$comment: Known-incomplete shipped token sets, per coverage dimension, with the reason each one is
not fixed yet. Read by scripts/audit-token-sets.mjs --check and by
tests/vitest/tokenSetCoverage.spec.js, so the CLI and the gate cannot disagree.
This file is a ratchet and it has to be able to fail BOTH ways: the gate fails on a set
below the bar that is not listed here, AND on a listed set that has started passing (delete
the entry). A reason shorter than 20 characters fails too, because an allow-list without
reasons is how a baseline becomes permanent. The previous stage-1 list was an empty array
of ids with no reasons at all, which is what made 'every shipped set is complete' readable
as a fact about an instance.
Baseline recorded 2026-10-04: bridge 8, font 0, logo 34, contrast 0.

bridge.amsterdam: Declares none of the 87 --utrecht-* names the bridge reads, so every button, table and form control keeps the Rijkshuisstijl default and only the accent colour changes. The fix is a scripts/brands/amsterdam.json that generate-brand-set.mjs turns into the component layer; no upstream source is recorded for this set, so the brand's own component mapping has to be sourced before a brand file can be written. Eight brand files exist for 56 sets, so these eight are a wave of their own and not this change.

logo.bodegraven-reeuwijk: An organisation's wordmark is its own trademark and thematiq must not vendor one: its upstream, nl-design-system/themes commit 9cfc4c5a, ships design tokens and no logo asset, so there is nothing we may redistribute. An administrator uploads the logo in the admin theming panel, which writes it to Nextcloud's own logo slot; until then the Nextcloud logo stays. This is a licensing question, not a technical one.
